WITH panel_age AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, initdate)) AS age_years,
        COUNT(*) AS num_panels
    FROM 
        plant
    GROUP BY 
        age_years
),
average_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, p.initdate)) AS age_years,
        AVG((efficiency_profile -> 'current_efficiency' ->> 'curreffpct')::NUMERIC) AS avg_efficiency
    FROM 
        performance AS pe
    JOIN 
        panel AS p ON pe.solmodref = p.panemark
    JOIN 
        plant AS pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
    GROUP BY 
        age_years
)
SELECT 
    pa.age_years AS panel_age,
    ae.avg_efficiency AS average_metric,
    pa.num_panels
FROM 
    panel_age AS pa
JOIN 
    average_efficiency AS ae ON pa.age_years = ae.age_years
ORDER BY 
    pa.age_years;

SELECT 
  T1.equipmenttype AS Equipment, 
  T4.heaterstatus AS "Heater Status", 
  T5.insulationstatus AS "Insulation Status", 
  T2.emergencylightstatus AS "Emergency Light Status", 
  T3.structuralloadpercent AS "Structure Load", 
  T6.operationalstatus AS "Readiness Label" 
FROM 
  equipment AS T1 
  JOIN lightingandsafety AS T2 ON T1.equipmentcode = T2.lighteqref 
  JOIN weatherandstructure AS T3 ON T3.weatherlocref = T7.locationregistry 
  JOIN cabinenvironment AS T4 ON T1.equipmentcode = T4.cabineqref 
  JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid AS T5 ON T1.equipmentcode = T5.thermaleqref 
  JOIN operationmaintenance AS T6 ON T1.equipmentcode = T6.opmainteqref 
  JOIN location AS T7 ON T1.equipmentcode = T7.loceqref 
WHERE 
  T3.structuralintegritystatus IN ('Critical', 'Warning') 
  AND T6.operationalstatus = 'Active';

WITH FanIdolCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        i.interactfanpivot AS fan_id, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) AS idol_count
    FROM 
        interactions i
    GROUP BY 
        i.interactfanpivot
),
FanIdolNames AS (
    SELECT 
        i.interactfanpivot AS fan_id, 
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT vi.nametag, ', ') AS idol_names
    FROM 
        interactions i
    JOIN 
        virtualidols vi ON i.interactidolpivot = vi.entityreg
    GROUP BY 
        i.interactfanpivot
),
FanAvgEngagement AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.memberfanpivot AS fan_id, 
        AVG(e.socintscore) AS avg_engagement
    FROM 
        membershipandspending ms
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON ms.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
    GROUP BY 
        ms.memberfanpivot
)

SELECT 
    f.userregistry AS user_id, 
    f.nicklabel AS nickname, 
    fic.idol_count, 
    fin.idol_names, 
    fae.avg_engagement
FROM 
    fans f
JOIN 
    FanIdolCounts fic ON f.userregistry = fic.fan_id
JOIN 
    FanIdolNames fin ON f.userregistry = fin.fan_id
JOIN 
    FanAvgEngagement fae ON f.userregistry = fae.fan_id
WHERE 
    fic.idol_count > 1
ORDER BY 
    fic.idol_count DESC, fae.avg_engagement DESC;

WITH panel_age AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, p.initdate)) AS age,
        COUNT(p.growregistry) AS num_panels,
        AVG(efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct')::DECIMAL AS avg_efficiency
    FROM 
        plant p
    JOIN 
        performance perf ON p.growregistry = perf.solmodref
    GROUP BY 
        age
),
panel_age_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN age BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '0-5 years' 
            WHEN age BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 years' 
            WHEN age BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '11-15 years' 
            WHEN age BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '16-20 years' 
            ELSE '20+ years' 
        END AS age_range, 
        SUM(num_panels) AS total_panels, 
        AVG(avg_efficiency) AS average_efficiency 
    FROM 
        panel_age 
    GROUP BY 
        age_range
)
SELECT 
    age_range, 
    average_efficiency, 
    total_panels
FROM 
    panel_age_ranges
ORDER BY 
    age_range;

    weatherandstructure ws ON e.equipmentcode = ws.weatherlocref

    AND tswg.insulationstatus = 'Good'
    AND las.emergencylightstatus = 'On'

WITH FanIdolCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        i.interactfanpivot AS fan_id, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) AS idol_count
    FROM 
        interactions i
    GROUP BY 
        i.interactfanpivot
),
FanIdolDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        f.userregistry AS user_id,
        f.nicklabel AS nickname,
        fic.idol_count,
        STRING_AGG(vi.nametag, ', ') AS idol_names,
        AVG(e.socintscore) AS avg_engagement
    FROM 
        fans f
    JOIN 
        FanIdolCounts fic ON f.userregistry = fic.fan_id
    JOIN 
        interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
    JOIN 
        virtualidols vi ON i.interactidolpivot = vi.entityreg
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON i.activityreg = e.engageactivitypivot
    WHERE 
        fic.idol_count > 1
    GROUP BY 
        f.userregistry, f.nicklabel, fic.idol_count
)
SELECT 
    user_id, 
    nickname, 
    idol_count, 
    idol_names, 
    avg_engagement
FROM 
    FanIdolDetails
ORDER BY 
    idol_count DESC, 
    avg_engagement DESC;

WITH case_risk AS (
    SELECT 
        invdetreg,
        behansc AS behavioral_analysis_score,
        netansc AS network_analysis_score,
        -- Calculate the Investigation Intensity Index
        ROUND((behansc * 0.6) + (netansc * 0.4), 2) AS intensity_index
    FROM investigationdetails
),
blocked_actions AS (
    SELECT 
        enf.enforcereg AS enforcement_action_id,
        enf.compref2 AS compliance_case_id,
        cr.behavioral_analysis_score,
        cr.network_analysis_score,
        cr.intensity_index
    FROM enforcementactions enf
    JOIN case_risk cr ON enf.invdetref = cr.invdetreg
    WHERE enf.resstat != 'Resolved'
    AND cr.intensity_index > 70
)
SELECT * FROM blocked_actions;

WITH cte AS (
    SELECT
        df.RecordRegistry AS flow_id,
        CASE
            WHEN df.OrigNation != df.DestNation THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS cross_border_risk_factor,
        rm.RiskAssess AS data_risk,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dp.CDVR DESC) AS risk_rank
    FROM
        Dataflow df
    JOIN
        RiskManagement rm ON df.RecordRegistry = rm.FlowLink
    JOIN
        DataProfile dp ON rm.RiskTrace = dp.RiskJoin
    WHERE
        dp.CDVR > 1000
)
SELECT
    flow_id,
    cross_border_risk_factor,
    data_risk,
    risk_rank
FROM
    cte
ORDER BY
    risk_rank
LIMIT 5;

FROM

WHERE

ORDER BY

WITH panel_age AS (
    SELECT 
        p.panemark,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pl.initdate) AS age
    FROM 
        panel p
    JOIN 
        plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
),
age_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        panemark, 
        CASE 
            WHEN age < 5 THEN '0-5' 
            WHEN age >= 5 AND age < 10 THEN '5-10' 
            WHEN age >= 10 AND age < 15 THEN '10-15' 
            ELSE '15+' 
        END AS age_range, 
        age
    FROM 
        panel_age
),
performance_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        p.panemark, 
        JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'curreffpct')::NUMERIC AS curreffpct
    FROM 
        performance p
),
panel_performance AS (
    SELECT 
        ar.panemark, 
        ar.age_range, 
        ar.age,
        pm.curreffpct
    FROM 
        age_ranges ar
    JOIN 
        performance_metrics pm ON ar.panemark = pm.panemark
)
SELECT 
    age_range, 
    AVG(curreffpct) AS avg_curreffpct, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT panemark) AS num_panels
FROM 
    panel_performance
GROUP BY 
    age_range
ORDER BY 
    age_range;

    t2.usbpwrline != 'USB-PD23'

SELECT 
    e.equipmenttype AS equipment, 
    ce.heaterstatus AS "heater status", 
    tswg.insulationstatus AS "insulation status", 
    las.emergencylightstatus AS "emergency light status", 
    ws.structuralloadpercent AS "structure margin", 
    om.operationalstatus AS "readiness label" 
FROM 
    equipment AS e 
JOIN 
    cabinenvironment AS ce ON e.equipmentcode = ce.cabineqref 
JOIN 
    thermalsolarwindandgrid AS tswg ON e.equipmentcode = tswg.thermaleqref 
JOIN 
    lightingandsafety AS las ON e.equipmentcode = las.lighteqref 
JOIN 
    weatherandstructure AS ws ON e.equipmentcode = ws.weatherlocref 
JOIN 
    operationmaintenance AS om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref 
JOIN 
    location AS l ON e.equipmentcode = l.loceqref 
WHERE 
    ws.externaltemperaturec < 0 
    AND ws.windspeedms > 10 
    AND ws.snowdepthcm > 10 
    AND om.operationalstatus = 'Operational' 
    AND ce.heaterstatus = 'On' 
    AND tswg.insulationstatus = 'Good' 
    AND las.emergencylightstatus = 'On';

WITH BlockedActions AS (
    SELECT 
        ea.enforcereg AS enforcement_action_id,
        ea.compref2 AS compliance_case_id,
        id.behansc AS behavioral_analysis_score,
        id.netansc AS network_analysis_score,
        (
            (
                (
                    id.behansc * 0.4
                ) + (
                    id.netansc * 0.6
                )
            ) * 100
        ) AS investigation_intensity_index
    FROM 
        enforcementactions ea
    JOIN 
        investigationdetails id ON ea.invdetref = id.invdetreg
    JOIN 
        compliancecase cc ON ea.compref2 = cc.compreg
    WHERE 
        ea.resstat != 'Resolved'
        AND cc.risksc > 0.5
)
SELECT 
    enforcement_action_id,
    compliance_case_id,
    behavioral_analysis_score,
    network_analysis_score,
    ROUND(
        investigation_intensity_index, 2
    ) AS investigation_intensity_index
FROM 
    BlockedActions;

    SELECT

        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENTdataE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pl.initdate) AS age
    FROM 
        panel p
    JOIN 
        plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
),
age_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        panemark, 
        CASE 
            WHEN age < 5 THEN '0-5' 
            WHEN age >= 5 AND age < 10 THEN '5-10' 
            WHEN age >= 10 AND age < 15 THEN '10-15' 
            ELSE '15+' 
        END AS age_range, 
        age
    FROM

),
performance_metrics AS (
    SELECT

),

        ar.panemark,

    FROM 
        age_ranges ar
    JOIN 
        performance_metrics pm ON ar.panemark = pm.panemark
)

    ea.compref2 AS compliance_case_id,
    id.behansc AS behavioral_analysis_score,
    id.netansc AS network_analysis_score,
    ROUND((id.behansc + id.netansc) / 2, 2) AS investigation_intensity_index,
    cc.risksc AS risk_score
FROM 
    enforcementactions ea
JOIN 
    compliancecase cc ON ea.compref2 = cc.compreg
JOIN 
    investigationdetails id ON ea.invdetref = id.invdetreg
WHERE 
    ea.resstat != 'Resolved' 
    AND cc.risksc > 0.5;

WITH cte AS (
    SELECT 
        df.RecordRegistry AS flow_id,
        (rm.RiskAssess * 
            CASE 
                WHEN df.OrigNation != df.DestNation THEN 2
                ELSE 1
            END) AS cross_border_risk_factor,
        dp.DataSense AS data_risk,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dp.DataSense DESC) AS data_risk_rank
    FROM 
        Dataflow df
    JOIN 
        RiskManagement rm ON df.RecordRegistry = rm.FlowLink
    JOIN 
        DataProfile dp ON rm.RiskTrace = dp.RiskJoin
    WHERE 
        df.CDVR > 1000
)
SELECT 
    flow_id,
    cross_border_risk_factor,
    data_risk,
    data_risk_rank
FROM 
    cte
ORDER BY 
    data_risk_rank
LIMIT 5;
